task_instruction: 示例（非正式测试案例）：评估两个候选选题方向——「不确定性量化机器学习势函数迁移到硫化物电解质界面」与「预训练视觉 Transformer 用于聚合物电解质膜裂纹分割」——在新颖性（仅池内判定）、前提三分源可行性与有界建议上的表现。

candidate_directions.title: 不确定性量化机器学习势函数迁移到硫化物电解质界面
candidate_directions.description: 研究对象：硫化物固态电解质界面离子输运。关键变量：界面迁移势垒与不确定性区间宽度。基线：bulk 数据训练的机器学习势函数。预期结论：带不确定性量化的迁移势函数在界面区外推误差显著低于 bulk 基线。可证伪：若界面区外推误差相对基线改善不显著，则该假设不成立。方法：迁移学习加不确定性量化的机器学习势函数。数据：自建界面 DFT 轨迹与表征图像。
candidate_directions.object: 硫化物固态电解质界面（grain boundary 与 interphase）
candidate_directions.baseline: bulk 数据训练的机器学习势函数
candidate_directions.expected: 带不确定性量化的迁移势函数在界面区外推误差显著低于 bulk 基线
candidate_directions.falsification: 若界面区外推误差相对基线的改善不显著，则该假设不成立
candidate_directions.method: 迁移学习加不确定性量化（ensemble/贝叶斯）的机器学习势函数
candidate_directions.data: 自建界面 DFT 轨迹与表征图像
candidate_directions.application: 固态电池界面设计与失效预测

claims.claim: We propose a framework for training machine learning potentials with calibrated uncertainty quantification for sulfide electrolyte interfaces
We collect in-situ interface trajectories with uncertainty labels and release them as an open annotated dataset for sulfide electrolytes

candidate_directions.title: 预训练视觉 Transformer 用于聚合物电解质膜裂纹分割
candidate_directions.description: 研究对象：聚合物电解质膜中的裂纹扩展。关键变量：裂纹分割 IoU 与标注样本量。基线：从零训练的 U-Net。预期结论：预训练 Transformer 在小样本条件下的裂纹分割 IoU 高于从零训练基线。可证伪：若 IoU 无显著提升，则迁移假设不成立。方法：预训练视觉 Transformer 微调。数据：自建聚合物电解质膜裂纹图像集。
candidate_directions.object: 聚合物电解质膜中的裂纹扩展
candidate_directions.expected: 预训练 Transformer 在小样本条件下的裂纹分割 IoU 高于从零训练基线
candidate_directions.falsification: 若 IoU 相对从零训练基线无显著提升，则迁移假设不成立
candidate_directions.method: 预训练视觉 Transformer 微调
candidate_directions.data: 自建聚合物电解质膜裂纹图像集

records.title: Uncertainty-aware machine learning potentials for sulfide interfaces
records.abstract: We propose a framework for training machine learning potentials with calibrated uncertainty quantification for sulfide electrolyte interfaces. Ensemble variance correlates with force error on interface trajectories.

records.title: Transfer learning of potentials from bulk to interfaces
records.abstract: We apply transfer learning of machine learning potentials from bulk training data to interface coating problems. The transferred potential is compared against a bulk-trained baseline and reduces interface force error.

records.title: Operando characterization of sulfide electrolyte interfaces
records.abstract: Operando XPS and Raman characterization track interphase evolution at sulfide electrolyte interfaces during cycling.

records.title: Convolutional segmentation of grain boundaries in solid electrolytes
records.abstract: We apply a convolutional segmentation network to electron microscopy images of grain boundaries in solid electrolytes and report reusable grain statistics.

records.title: Deep learning grain boundary detection in ceramics
records.abstract: A deep learning pipeline detects grain boundaries in ceramic micrographs and reports an F1 score of 0.91 on the ceramic benchmark.

records.title: Space charge layers dominate sulfide interface resistance
records.abstract: Impedance and simulation show that space charge layers dominate interface resistance in sulfide electrolytes.

records.title: Compositional screening of fast ionic conductors
records.abstract: A data-driven screening ranks candidate fast ionic conductors using compositional descriptors and reports two promising families.

records.title: Benchmarking uncertainty quantification for atomistic simulations
records.abstract: A benchmark compares uncertainty quantification methods for atomistic simulations of solid interfaces; ensemble and dropout calibrations are evaluated on force and energy error.

records.title: Cryo-EM interphase composition in sulfide electrolytes
records.abstract: Cryogenic electron microscopy reveals nanoscale interphase composition at sulfide electrolyte interfaces and quantifies lithium sulfide fractions.

records.title: Open benchmark dataset for solid electrolyte conductivity
records.abstract: We release an open benchmark dataset for solid electrolyte ionic conductivity covering 200 compositions with measured conductivity values.
